items.name: H1_bgm_groove
items.text: Ancient Egyptian storytelling background music, 104 BPM: Hijaz scale on D (D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat, C) over a low D and A drone; a darbuka playing the Egyptian maqsum rhythm (doum-tek, tek-doum, tek) with soft riq jingles and occasional finger cymbals; an oud plucking a repeating Hijaz ostinato; a soft nasal reed (mizmar / ney) playing short, quiet phrases that rise D, E-flat, F-sharp, G, A, B-flat and fall back to D. It is BACKGROUND MUSIC that sits under on-screen subtitles in a short history video: understated, steady and low-key, no big build-ups, no climaxes, no loud solos, nothing that grabs attention; the melody stays soft and in the background, leaving space; consistent energy from start to end. Instrumental, no vocals.
